answer.text:
No, channel partner subscriptions are not auto-renewed. When an order is placed through a resale partner, auto-renewal is deactivated. Partners and end customers are not obligated to renew solely because a cancellation notice was not submitted within the standard 30-day window. The partner holds the commercial relationship with the end customer, so renewal decisions on indirect (partner) deals are managed through the partner, not enforced by GitLab directly.

<details>
<summary markdown="span">
Does GitLab enforce auto-renewal on deals transacted through a partner?
</summary>

No. GitLab does not enforce auto-renewal on partner-transacted deals. When an order is placed through a resale partner, auto-renewal is deactivated. Partners and end customers are not obligated to renew solely because a cancellation notice was not submitted within the standard 30-day window.

This policy exists because the partner holds the commercial relationship with the end customer. Renewal decisions on indirect deals should be managed through the partner, not enforced by GitLab directly.
